research.topic: Juventus vs Napoli – using the hype around the high‑stakes football clash to show students how to handle performance pressure and exam anxiety
verified: Performance anxiety triggers a surge in cortisol, the body’s primary stress hormone.
Performance anxiety may affect working memory, with some studies indicating possible impairment when cortisol levels are high, while other research finds no clear effect.
Elevated cortisol can impair working memory, essential for exam information manipulation.

research.hook: Zyada padhna = kam yaad. Jaise Juventus aur Napoli ka match, tumhara anxiety bhi ek rival hai – yeh 3 tricks use karo aur exam hall mein jeet lo.
research.tip: Before opening the exam paper, spend 60 seconds doing the 4‑7‑8 breathing rhythm (inhale 4 sec, hold 7 sec, exhale 8 sec) to quickly dampen cortisol spikes.
